title: Braking Distance Under Constant Deceleration
description: A car moving at u=20 m/s decelerates at a=-4 m/s^2 under braking. Find time to stop and stopping distance.

strategies.name: Kinematics Braking Approach
strategies.description: Solve for time to stop then apply the displacement equation.
strategies.master_solution:
Step 1: Given u=20, a=-4, time to stop is t = (0 - u)/a = (0 - 20)/-4 = 5
Step 2: Stopping distance is s = u*t + 0.5*a*t^2 = 20*5 + 0.5*-4*25 = 50
